Package org.eclipse.microprofile.metrics

Class MetricUnits

java.lang.Object
org.eclipse.microprofile.metrics.MetricUnits
public final class MetricUnits extends Object
Standard units constants for metric's Metadata. This class provides a list of common metric units and is not meant to be a complete list of possible units.
